channel.title: Science for the Curious
channel.description: One everyday question, one clear scientific answer.

item.title: Why Does Ice Float on Water?
item.description: Why frozen water is lighter than liquid water, how much of an iceberg hides underwater, and why this odd property keeps lakes from freezing solid.

item.title: How a Microwave Oven Actually Heats Your Food
item.description: What the FDA's official explanation says about magnetrons, water molecules, and the safety standard that limits microwave leakage from ovens.

item.title: How a Rainbow Actually Forms
item.description: A plain explanation of the light bending and splitting inside raindrops that creates a rainbow, based on NOAA and National Weather Service guidance.

item.title: Why Is the Sky Blue
item.description: NASA's explanation of why sunlight scatters into a blue sky during the day and why sunsets turn red, using the physics of light scattering.

item.title: Why You See Lightning Before You Hear Thunder
item.description: NOAA's explanation of why thunder is created, why it arrives after lightning, and how to use the 5-second rule to estimate how far away a storm is.
